verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the square layout scaled down and centred on a taller canvas. In both, the pill tags and the URL line are now tiny, the 'missing asset' placeholder box is still there, and the can floats on its own to the right of the date block. A spreads the stack down the taller canvas so the top and bottom margins are more even. B compresses the content upward, which leaves a cramped middle and a large empty band at the bottom under the RSVP/URL group.
